main.description: Fulfillment policy set evaluated by pre-defined, first-party policies named in the evaluator's registry. Executed in an in-process Deno worker sandbox with no permissions; all record resolution is brokered by the host. Carries downstream through subcontracting chains.

policies.description: Named policies to evaluate; all must allow.

requesterDid.description: ATProto DID of the root requester this policy set was minted for.

name.description: Registry name of the policy to run (for example only-me, tangled-vouch, mutuals, under-4-cpus).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this policy admits.

args.description: Arguments passed to the policy. Well-known keys: bidWindowSec, firstFree.
